name: creator_diagnostic
description: Measure how a creator edits from up to 30 posts (links or local files): cut rate, shot lengths, speech pace, opening line, music, beat-cutting, aspect, length, palette. Medians over the most-viewed `top`, plus per-video values and stills. One item: a one-video breakdown. Downloaded videos and `inbox` videos are deleted once measured.

output.description: {out, diagnostic, measured, failed}. diagnostic.json (schema 1) and stills/ are in out.

params.name: items
params.description: JSON array, newest first: [{"url": "..."} or {"path": "..."}, plus optional "views", "likes", "posted_at" (YYYY-MM-DD), "caption"]

params.name: profile
params.description: Instead of items: a TikTok or YouTube profile link

params.name: out
params.description: Folder for diagnostic.json and stills/ (default: temp)

params.name: inbox
params.description: Folder holding videos saved for this run; each is deleted once measured

params.name: top
params.description: How many posts to measure: the most-viewed, else the newest
